links.comparator_used: LLM alone (AI acting alone) answering the same vignette questions
links.outcome: Diagnostic reasoning score on structured vignette questions
links.effect: Physicians with LLM assistance scored lower than the LLM alone (mean difference 21.3 percentage points, p<0.001)
links.tradeoff: Physicians posed only 30% of case questions directly to the LLM, which suggests under-utilisation contributed to the gap. Improvement from LLM assistance varied widely between clinicians (SD 12.8%).
links.quote: Physicians with LLM assistance scored significantly lower than the LLM alone (mean difference 21.3 percentage points, p<0.001).

design_hint: LLM access for clinicians vs conventional resources (human-AI collaboration)
